title: Geometric and coefficient operations on a fixed semilinear system calculus
statement: Fix the Data structure of [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus] for an arbitrary inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves on a small site. For every geometric morphism presented by a finite-limit-preserving inverse image on sheaves, there is a Geometry structure of [def-coef-semilinear-geometry-ops] whose PullTransitionFormula holds. For every compatible morphism of ring towers there is a ScalarSystems structure, and for every object of the site there is an OpenSystems structure. The push-transition formula and projection-evaluation equality are not assumptions of this result: they are proved categorically in the parent module.

proof.text: Apply $u^{-1}$ and $u_*$ termwise on the underlying sequence topoi. Their adjunction follows by applying the original adjunction at every index: the naturality equations for a family of maps correspond under transposition. The inverse image preserves finite limits and colimits, so is exact on module systems, with coefficient ring $C_\bullet=u^{-1}B_\bullet$. This is a morphism of the two ringed sequence topoi. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] and [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] there. They give $V\dashv G=Ru_{*,\bullet}$, with $G$ computed by a K-injective system resolution and $V$ termwise exact. The unit and counit here are maps in the ordinary derived categories of systems.

proof.text:
Write $L_n^B,L_n^C$ for the finite left extensions on the two sites. On a flat-term K-flat representative $P$, inverse image and coefficient tensor give $VE_n^BP\cong E_n^Cu^{-1}P$, with the same zero components above $n$. The isomorphism is $u^{-1}(P\otimes_{B_n}B_q)\cong u^{-1}P\otimes_{C_n}C_q$. K-flat pullback and derived tensor/pullback identify it as $VL_n^B\cong L_n^Cu^{-1}$ on the ordinary derived categories. For $P\in D(B_n)$ and $N\in D(\mathscr S(C))$, the natural bijections
$$\operatorname{Hom}(P,e_nGN)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(L_n^BP,GN)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(VL_n^BP,N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(L_n^Cu^{-1}P,N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(u^{-1}P,N_n)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(P,Ru_{*,n}N_n)$$
therefore give $e_nG\cong Ru_{*,n}e_n$ by Yoneda. This proves the formula without any preservation of K-injectives by evaluation.

proof.text:
Use the canonical adjunctions in the preceding Hom bijections. The derived adjunction formula on a resolving representative is the ordinary tensor-adjoint formula: its unit sends $x$ to $x\otimes1$, and its transpose sends $x\otimes a$ to $a h(x)$. This follows from the canonical pre-derived adjunction formula of [lem-pc-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general], with the identity resolving leg, and then naturality in a K-flat resolution. Consequently the Hom bijections defining $e_nG$ carry the evaluated unit and counit to the level unit and counit: applying the bijection to an identity gives its unit, and applying its inverse to an identity gives its counit. The comparison $VL_n^B\cong L_n^Cu^{-1}$ commutes with $\sigma_{mn}$, since its two composites are the same inverse-image tensor reassociation on $q\leq n$ and zero above. Transpose this square. The reduction transition of $GN$ becomes $G_n(t^N_{m,n})b_{m,n}$, where $b$ is the transpose of
$$u^{-1}T_{m,n}G_m\xrightarrow{q^{-1}}S_{m,n}u^{-1}G_m\xrightarrow{S_{m,n}\varepsilon_m}S_{m,n}.$$
Ordinary mate pasting gives the composition law. This proves compatibility of evaluations with the adjunction maps and coefficient transitions, not merely the evaluated objects.

proof.text: For an open localization apply $j_!,j^*$ at each level. Their exactness and adjunction follow from [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], by transposing the transition equations. Both exact functors are their own total derived functors [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor], so they descend termwise and retain their adjunction by [lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors]. To compute coefficient change, use the slice projection identity [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-extension-tensor]. It also proves $j_!$ preserves flatness: tensoring an exact sequence with $j_!F$ is exact $j_!$ applied to its exact restriction tensored with flat $F$. For K-flat $P$ and acyclic $A$, $(j_!P)\otimes A\cong j_!(P\otimes j^*A)$ is acyclic, proving K-flatness. Thus the same identity on K-flat resolutions gives the derived coefficient comparison. On an extension summand it sends $x\otimes b$ to $x\otimes j^*b$; iterated coefficient changes agree as balanced tensors. All these are transformations on systems before localization and so have the stated ordinary derived system models.

proof.text: A compatible ring-system map $B_\bullet\to D_\bullet$ is a map of ring sheaves on the sequence site. Apply derived ringed-topos pullback for the identity topos [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback], resolving by flat-term K-flat complexes on that site. Their evaluations are flat-term K-flat by step 3, so evaluation of extension is exactly $M_n\otimes^L_{B_n}D_n$. Tensor and coefficient composition are obtained from total tensor rebracketing. The monoidal and composition comparisons of [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons] apply both to the sequence topos and to each evaluation morphism. They prove compatibility with tensor associativity, units, symmetry and iterated pullback. Thus these comparisons are actual natural transformations on ordinary derived systems, with the indicated evaluation formulas, for arbitrary coefficient maps.

proof.text: Form each specified exchange by its unit/composition/counit word [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] for the derived functors on the ringed sequence topoi; for an open map use $j_!\dashv j^*$ instead. Pullback composition and direct-image composition use the normalized ordinary comparisons [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Every letter is already a system functor or transformation. Evaluation of those letters is the level letter, including the unit and counit by step 9 and the exact open adjunction by step 10. Hence evaluation of the word is the corresponding level word. The same applies to any specified composite with open extension or proper direct image. Ordinary mate pasting proves compatibility with composition on the system category itself. No properness was needed to construct a direct-image composition, and no invertibility of a mate is inferred.

proof.text: For geometric tensor pullback use the inverse-image pure-tensor comparison on each total-complex summand, with the inverse ordinary comparison as its recorded inverse. The differential signs make these chain maps. Resolving on the system site by K-flat complexes with flat terms gives the normalized derived comparison; hence its specification is checked before evaluation, without assuming derived evaluation is faithful.
